command:
$paths = @(
  'orchestrator_harness/cli.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/codex_adapter.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/invocation.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/lane_controller.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/provider.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/claude_adapter.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/claude_installer.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/assets/claude/orchestrator_harness_post_tool_use.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/assets/claude/orchestrator_harness_stop.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/tests/test_compat_claude_adapter.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/tests/test_compat_provider_allowlist.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/tests/test_compat_provider_argv.py',
  'orchestrator_harness/tests/test_compat_transcript_parse.py',
  'examples/disposable_claude_coding_fixture.py'
)
uv run --project .codex/dev --locked ruff check --config .codex/dev/pyproject.toml --no-cache @paths
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
uv run --project .codex/dev --locked basedpyright --project pyrightconfig.json @paths
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
uv run --project .codex/dev --locked python -m py_compile @paths
exit $LASTEXITCODE
timeout_basis: ROOT CP-01 changed-Python static gate; observed focused execution is under 25 seconds and 120 seconds covers Ruff, BasedPyright, compilation, and dependency startup with 30 seconds cleanup
